notes: Rows 0..7 over random 0xca-byte grid records whose current entries (0..15) have kinds 0..8, 0xff and random; row states including the busy patrol states, link words 0xff or not, unit modes 0..2, the active row equal or not with its watched unit and player flag matching or not; random results for the clock, reach, weight, within-reach and assign checks. 0xb4250 runs as original code; all other callees are logging stubs that record their register contract (AX for 0x85400, 0x2b508 and 0x488f8, whose mode is DL; EAX/EDX for 0x2b1f4 and 0x2b0b4; EAX otherwise).
